messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — I'm updating the v2 docs to clarify auth param rename. A bunch of examples still show ?api_key=xxx and folks are pasting that into SDK calls which now expect Authorization header. I'll open a PR in ~30m. Anyone seen customer confusion on this recently?

ajay: Yup — had a support ticket yesterday. SDK returns 401 with misleading msg: "missing api_key param" in older error handler. We're shipping a patch to normalize errors but docs change needed asap.

lucy: Can we standardize on Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN> examples only? Also include curl & Node + python snippets. Small note: internal infra still logs redacted api_key occurrences, so keep both examples in migration guide for a week.

phil: Agree. Also add a short checkbox in migration guide: header-based auth, avoid query param, token rotation steps. I'll add a sentence about telemetry impact — queries with api_key show higher 4xx rate in the last 72h.

maria: Plan: (1) swap all examples to header form, (2) add migration subsection showing old->new examples, (3) call out known SDK error strings + patch link. I'll tag PR w/ docs-review.

[docs-ci-bot]: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4223 — 'docs(v2): auth examples -> Authorization header + migration note' :white_check_mark:

ajay: Thanks. I'll add a short SDK note in the README: will accept query param for a 30-day grace period but emit a warning. Code snippet for Node to add to guide:

```js
// preferred
fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${TOKEN}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'redwood-1', prompt: 'hi' })
})
```

lucy: For curl and python snippets, I'll PR minor formatting fixes. Also propose a tiny banner at top of v2 pages: 'Note: older query param auth is deprecated — see migration guide'.

phil: Can we add a metric link in the migration guide to the 4xx dashboard? Helps support.

maria: Yes — I'll add a link to the 'auth-deprecation' dashboard. Also adding a short FAQ: 'I copied example and got 401' -> explain header vs query param and show fix.

ajay: One more: make sure examples warn about logging tokens in shell history when using curl with -H vs embedding in url.

maria: Good catch. I'll include a line about that and mention aws/azure proxy patterns.

lucy: I'll queue a quick smoke test to verify docs snippets run with the new SDK patch once it's merged.

maria: Great — target ship: EOD PST. Ping me if you want to eyeball wording. :thumbsup:
